# Deepanshi Singh

> Deepanshi Singh is a physics master's student at Université Paris-Saclay, with research experience in exoplanets, Fast Radio Bursts, cosmic rays, globular clusters and cosmology, alongside student leadership and science outreach.

Canonical URL: https://singh-deepanshi.github.io/

## About

Physics master's student at Université Paris-Saclay with research experience in exoplanets, Fast Radio Bursts, cosmic rays, globular clusters and cosmology. Also active in physics student leadership, conference organisation and science outreach.

## Main sections

- Research: six research experiences, including exoplanet characterisation, cosmic-ray studies, FRB cosmology, NGC 5466, cosmological statistical methods and QuarkNet muon-flux analysis.
- Leadership and outreach: IUPAP AC5 Council, Indian Network of Physics Students / IAPS, and Vidyut Physics Society at Miranda House.
- Talks and workshops: research presentations, invited speaking and workshops listed on the site.
- Background: education, additional schools and training, awards, skills and selected coursework.
